title: Dicho de otro modo: reformular una idea para aclararla

sections.content: Dicho de otro modo (put another way, in other words) rephrases an idea just expressed, usually to make it clearer or more concrete -- useful in balanced, analytical writing that wants to restate a complex point from a slightly different angle. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Dicho de otro modo, estas reformas rescataron a la región de una espiral inflacionaria que amenazaba con destruirlo todo.
items.english: Put another way, these reforms rescued the region from an inflationary spiral that threatened to destroy everything.

items.spanish: Dicho de otro modo, muchos analistas resumen el legado neoliberal como una paradoja.
items.english: In other words, many analysts sum up the neoliberal legacy as a paradox.

items.spanish: El modelo logró domar la inflación; dicho de otro modo, resolvió un problema mientras dejaba otro sin resolver.
items.english: The model managed to tame inflation; put another way, it solved one problem while leaving another unresolved.

items.spanish: Dicho de otro modo, la estabilidad macroeconómica no garantizó, por sí sola, ni equidad ni resiliencia frente a futuras crisis.
items.english: In other words, macroeconomic stability alone guaranteed neither equity nor resilience against future crises.

sections.content: Dicho de otro modo works best right after a somewhat abstract or technical claim, offering the reader a clearer restatement -- similar to es decir, but signaling a genuine reformulation rather than just a clarifying example.
